Treatment summary
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and
reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported knee trauma, and the presenting
symptoms are plausible for an impact of this kind. Over the course of 18 visits, care included physical examination,
imaging, a structured rehabilitation program, and activity modification. Imaging and clinical examination findings
clearly confirm the knee injury. The patient's history inlcudes a small strain to the same region many years ago, which
resolved completely without lasting limitation and did not affect the current presentation. Treatment followed a typical
clinical course, with visit frequency and intensity decreasing steadily as strength, mobility, and pain improved. Billed
services reflect the treatment delivered, with no repeated or duplicate charges. At the most recent evaluation, the
patient was progressing well and was discharged to a self-directed home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
